verdict.justification: Both deliverables accurately calculate the core cost savings and cover all required sections of the prompt. However, Deliverable A is noticeably stronger because it includes a structured sensitivity table as encouraged by the prompt, accurately calculates the percentage of the localised pack cost that remains imported (97.2%), and breaks the next steps into an actionable, owner-assigned table. Deliverable B makes a mathematical/framing error by stating that '~85% of pack cost stays USD-linked' (85% is the share of the old cost, whereas INR 705,500 out of the new INR 726,090 cost is 97.2%). Both deliverables awkwardly break the fourth wall by mentioning empty workspace folders, though Deliverable B handles this slightly less intrusively than Deliverable A.

decisive_issues.issue: Incorrectly states that ~85% of the localised pack cost remains imported/USD-linked (705,500 / 726,090 is actually 97.2%; 85% is the share of the old 830,000 cost).
